card-editor.action-editor.action.note: Label of the dropdown that picks what happens on this gesture, such as toggle or navigate.

card-editor.action-editor.call-service.note: Dropdown option that runs a Home Assistant service (an action such as light.turn_on) on this gesture.

card-editor.action-editor.close-pop-up.note: Dropdown option that closes the Magic Card pop-up that is currently open.

card-editor.action-editor.closes-the-mag.text: Closes the Magic Card pop-up that is open (also from inside it).

card-editor.action-editor.double-tap.note: Heading of the action group that runs when the user taps the element twice quickly.

card-editor.action-editor.entity.note: Label of the entity picker inside an action, for actions that act on a chosen entity.

card-editor.action-editor.hold.note: Heading of the action group that runs when the user presses and holds the element.

card-editor.action-editor.navigate.note: Dropdown option that moves to another dashboard view or page when the gesture happens.

card-editor.action-editor.none.note: Dropdown option meaning this gesture does nothing.

card-editor.value-bg-editor.entity.note: Field label for the Home Assistant entity that drives the value background.

card-editor.value-bg-editor.fill.note: Value background type: a bar that fills in proportion to the value. Noun.

card-editor.value-bg-editor.fill-colour.note: Colour picker label for the inside of the filled bar or area.

card-editor.value-bg-editor.fill-directi.note: Field label for the side from which the fill bar grows: up, down, left or right.

card-editor.value-bg-editor.fill-opacity.note: Slider label for how see-through the fill bar is.

card-editor.value-bg-editor.fill-the-are.text: Fill the area under the line.

card-editor.value-bg-editor.history-that.text: History that can't be loaded draws nothing.

card-editor.value-bg-editor.hours.note: Field label for how many hours of history the sparkline or wave covers. Plural unit of time.

card-editor.value-bg-editor.left.note: Direction option: the background fills from the right edge towards the left.

card-editor.value-bg-editor.line-colour.note: Colour picker label for the line drawn along the sparkline or wave.

card-editor.value-bg-editor.max.note: Field label for the value at which the background is completely full. Short for maximum.

card-editor.value-bg-editor.min.note: Field label for the value at which the background is empty. Short for minimum.

card-editor.value-bg-editor.module-entit.note: Dropdown option in the value background editor that follows the module's own entity. {entity} is its entity ID.

vars.entity: The value that replaces entity in the text.

card-editor.value-bg-editor.off.note: Value background type that shows no background at all. Not an entity state.

card-editor.value-bg-editor.pick-an-enti.text: Pick an entity: a value background without one draws nothing.

card-editor.value-bg-editor.right.note: Direction option: the background fills from the left edge towards the right.

card-editor.value-bg-editor.smoothing.note: Field label for how strongly the sparkline or wave curve is rounded off. Noun.

card-editor.value-bg-editor.sparkline.note: Value background type: a small line chart of the entity's recent history. Charting term.

card-editor.value-bg-editor.the-area-fad.text: The area fades out upwards. The line stays faint ({pct}%) so text over it stays readable.
card-editor.value-bg-editor.the-area-fad.note: Description of the fade style for the value background. {pct} is the line opacity as a whole number, so the text reads 30% for 30.

vars.pct: The value that replaces pct in the text.

card-editor.value-bg-editor.type.note: Field label for choosing the kind of value background: off, fill, area, sparkline or wave.

card-editor.value-bg-editor.up.note: Direction option: the background fills from bottom to top.

card-editor.value-bg-editor.wave.note: Value background type: an animated wavy liquid level that rises with the value. Noun.

card-editor.vertical-editor.align.note: Field label for how items line up horizontally in a vertical stack. Verb used as a label.

card-editor.vertical-editor.centre.note: Alignment option: items sit in the middle of the stack's width. British spelling.

card-editor.vertical-editor.end.note: Alignment option: items sit against the end edge of the stack. Right in left-to-right layouts.

card-editor.vertical-editor.gap.note: Field label for the empty space between stacked items. Noun.

card-editor.vertical-editor.start.note: Alignment option: items sit against the start edge of the stack. Left in left-to-right layouts.

card-editor.vertical-editor.stretch.note: Alignment option: items grow to fill the full width of the stack. Verb used as an option.

card-editor.video-bg-editor.autoplay.note: Switch label: the background video starts playing as soon as the card loads.

card-editor.video-bg-editor.contain.note: Fit option: the whole video is visible, with empty bars if the shapes differ. CSS object-fit term.

card-editor.video-bg-editor.cover.note: Fit option: the video fills the whole card and may be cropped. CSS object-fit term.

card-editor.video-bg-editor.fit.note: Field label for how the video is sized to the card: contain or cover. Noun.

card-editor.video-bg-editor.loop.note: Switch label: the background video restarts when it reaches the end.

card-editor.video-bg-editor.muted.note: Switch label: the background video plays without sound. Adjective.

card-editor.video-bg-editor.plays-behind.text: Plays behind the other modules in the same column or layout. On its own in a column it shows at its own size.

card-editor.video-bg-editor.plays-while-.text: Plays while the card is visible (not with reduced motion).

card-editor.video-bg-editor.shown-until-.text: Shown until the video plays, and instead of it when it cannot play.

card-editor.video-bg-editor.video-url.note: Field label for the web address or file path of the background video. Keep URL.

card-editor.view-detect.matches-this-vie.note: Badge saying the card width fits a sections view. {columns} is how many of the 12 grid columns the card spans.

vars.columns: The value that replaces columns in the text.

card-editor.view-detect.narrow.note: Name of the dashboard view width class for small screens such as phones. Adjective.

card-editor.view-detect.panel.note: Name of the Home Assistant panel view type, where one card fills the whole page.

card-editor.view-detect.view-type-type-i.note: Warning when the dashboard view is of a type the card cannot adapt to. {type} is the view type name, such as masonry.

vars.type: The value that replaces type in the text.

card-editor.view-detect.wide.note: Name of the dashboard view width class for large screens such as desktops. Adjective.

card-editor.weather-editor.animated-icon.note: Switch label: use moving weather icons instead of still ones.

card-editor.weather-editor.animated-weat.text: Animated weather icons instead of static ones
card-editor.weather-editor.animated-weat.note: Help under the animated icons switch of the Weather module; the forecast editor has the same help for the Forecast module.

card-editor.weather-editor.forecast-days.note: Field label for how many days of forecast the weather module lists. Number input.

card-editor.weather-editor.show-conditio.note: Switch label: show the weather condition word, such as Cloudy. Show is a verb.

card-editor.weather-editor.show-forecast.note: Switch label: show the upcoming days' forecast under the current weather. Show is a verb.

card-editor.weather-editor.show-temperat.note: Switch label: show the current temperature number. Show is a verb.

card-editor.weather-editor.this-entity-h.text: This entity has no daily forecast; its first forecast type is shown. The Forecast module offers more options.

card-editor.weather-editor.weather-entit.note: Field label for the Home Assistant weather entity the module reads, such as weather.home.

card-editor.yaml-editor.copy-yaml.note: Button that copies the card's YAML code to the clipboard. Copy is a verb.

card-editor.yaml-editor.copying-failed-t.text: Copying failed: the browser blocked the clipboard.

card-editor.yaml-editor.n.text: {n, plural, one {Embed it to share this card with another Home Assistant.} other {Embed them to share this card with another Home Assistant.}}
card-editor.yaml-editor.n.note: Hint in the YAML editor. It refers to the custom animations the card uses: it for one, them for several. Plural forms follow the count.

vars.n: The count the text is about.

card-editor.yaml-editor.uses-n-of-your-a.text: {n, plural, one {Uses # of your animations.} other {Uses # of your animations.}}
card-editor.yaml-editor.uses-n-of-your-a.note: Hint in the YAML editor saying how many of the user's own custom animations the card refers to. {n} is a number.

vars.n: The number of animations the YAML uses.

card-editor.yaml-editor.yaml-copied.note: Confirmation shown after the YAML was copied to the clipboard.

card-editor.yaml-editor.yaml-copied-not-.note: Toast after copying YAML when some custom animations could not be found. {ids} is a comma-separated list of animation IDs.

vars.ids: The value that replaces ids in the text.
